headline: Highest risk is prompt-injection/data leakage via ChatGPT Desktop’s clipboard/files/screen-capture surfaces; LlamaFactory appears read-only and offline, limiting conflict.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop ingests clipboard, files, and screen captures by default-like workflows, so malicious content could be treated as instructions. LlamaFactory has no input surfaces or shared channel, so it is not itself a bridge; the interaction risk comes from ChatGPT Desktop’s permissive parsing of user-provided content.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop is given attacker-controlled text via clipboard, uploaded files, or screenshots.
IF LlamaFactory is used only as a local offline model with no shared channel to ChatGPT Desktop.
mitigations: Disable clipboard-based pasting for untrusted content.
Review uploaded files before sending them to ChatGPT Desktop.
Avoid using screenshots from untrusted sources as prompts.
Use a separate workspace for any content that may be adversarial.
requires-engineering: add provenance labeling for imported content.

B_data_leakage.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can read uploaded files and files from supported macOS apps, which can expose sensitive data to OpenAI’s vendor-mediated backend. LlamaFactory shows no file access or network egress, so it is not the leakage source; the pair risk is that data handled by ChatGPT Desktop may be surfaced in outputs while LlamaFactory remains unable to contain it.
conditions: IF sensitive files or app content are opened in ChatGPT Desktop.
IF those contents are summarized or copied into downstream outputs.
mitigations: Do not open secrets or regulated data in ChatGPT Desktop.
Use redacted copies of files before upload.
Restrict ChatGPT Desktop to non-sensitive projects.
Confirm no sensitive text is present before sharing outputs.
requires-engineering: enforce DLP/redaction before upload.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No write-capable overlap is present: ChatGPT Desktop cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, and LlamaFactory also lacks filesystem write, shell, or git mutation. Without shared mutable resources or locking concerns, there is no plausible capability conflict pathway.
conditions: IF either profile gains write access to the same directory or git repository.
IF an orchestrator adds shared mutable state not shown in the profiles.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only for shared repositories.
Separate any writable workspaces.
Avoid concurrent edits to the same files.
Use manual handoff instead of simultaneous mutation.
requires-engineering: add file-locking if write access is introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can produce summaries from files and app context, and LlamaFactory could be used to consume those outputs as if authoritative. Because LlamaFactory has no documented verification or critique mechanism in the profile, the pair can propagate hallucinations or omissions into downstream work products.
conditions: IF LlamaFactory is prompted to act on ChatGPT Desktop outputs without an explicit verification step.
IF ChatGPT Desktop’s extracted facts are forwarded into customer-support responses or other downstream artifacts.
mitigations: Require a human check before reuse of ChatGPT outputs.
Ask LlamaFactory to cite source text line-by-line.
Compare outputs against the original file or screenshot.
Mark ChatGPT summaries as untrusted drafts.
requires-engineering: add automated verification against source artifacts.

E_compliance.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code, creating a compliance surface for regulated data. LlamaFactory has no stated data handling or residency controls, so the pair’s compliance posture is asymmetric and undocumented; uncertainty pushes this above low because sensitive classes could flow into a vendor-managed service.
conditions: IF regulated data such as PHI, EU PII, or secrets is entered into ChatGPT Desktop.
IF retention, residency, or deletion requirements apply to the same data class.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of ChatGPT Desktop.
Use de-identified samples for testing.
Review vendor retention settings before use.
Document which data classes may be processed.
requires-engineering: obtain a DPA or equivalent compliance review.
